content_html:
#JyoAchyutananda : Sensible, Neat, Clean, Witty, Entertaining, Emotional, Engaging…….n the list goes on & on

u will be involved right go…shows directors capabilities with simple Title cards with 90’s super hits playing in background

#SrinivasAvasarala : take a bow for ur intelligence….Story Simple, Screenplay Top Notch (1st half), Dialogues toooooooo good….the way he involved witty dialogues (Nanna ki nuvu trails lo putavu raa Nenu Reals; I thank you from heart of my bottom) into a family entertainer but yet makes everyone to have a hearty laugh shows his Intelligence. Loved the charachterizations espcially of Nara Rohit ( never tried to give justification or reason behind his attitude in the whole movie ) which shows how much realistic the movie is. Yes i say realistic coz me n my brother flirted vth same girl who used to live in our above apartment when I was studying 5 – 6th 🙂

#NaraRohit : I was a fan of his movies right from Banam….n happy that he hit bulls eye atleast this time. The way he owned Achyuth charachterization is terrific. He carried the attitude of being a person without much emtional attachment n practical approach is superb and the cheery on cake is he never tried to justify or give proper reasoning 4 his behavior which made me to fall in love with his role…Superb Acting but Rowdy Fellow lo chepinatu Babu koncham boodu ga kaadhu baaaagha laavu ayyadu

#NagaSourya : 2 good for a budding artist….his looks innonce in face and the way he carried emotional scenes are superb

#Regina : she has completely fit into the role of jyo, n the way the.director potrayed her char of being a modern girl with mature thought process she did full justice

Kalyan Raman’s music is soothing with light BGM and melodious Title track….Cinematography is very good n apt.

I have seen lot many reviews complaining about 2nd half, come on u cannot expect a movie to be laugh riot. 2nd half is the core of the movie with emotions taking the front seat and yes its very very very good
